description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmployeeLanguageAPITest' for testing the 'EmployeeLanguageAPI' REST API endpoints related to employee language management in the OrangeHRM system. It includes tests for CRUD operations, validation rules, and fixture loading, focusing on the API's behavior within the HRM plugin module.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class extending EndpointTestCase, designed to verify the functionality, validation, and security aspects of the EmployeeLanguageAPI endpoints in OrangeHRM's HRM plugin. It includes methods to test CRUD operations, validation rules, fixture loading, and exception handling for employee language data.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads test fixtures from a YAML file to populate the database with initial employee language data for testing.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLanguageService
methods.description: Verifies that the API correctly returns an instance of EmployeeLanguageService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single employee language record, including checks for valid data and not found scenarios.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Ensures validation rules for 'getOne' include correct parameters and exception handling for invalid params.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests fetching all employee language records for a given employee, checking proper normalization and metadata.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the rule set for retrieving all employee languages, including access control and employee existence.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Assesses creating a new employee language entry, including validation, saving, and error conditions.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks validation rules for creating an employee language, including multi-rule validation and error aggregation.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employee language record, validating change propagation and error scenarios.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies the validation rules for updating, ensuring correct parameters and handling invalid input.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of employee languages, including successful removal and exception handling for not found.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks validation rules for delete operation, including validation of ID arrays and access rights.
